dedupe_keys.name: pictures and videos collected during odavs activity

description: Alessandro Carbonari and Massimo Vaccarini at Università Politecnica delle Marche describe video and audio observations from the ENCORE On-site Analysis and Verification Service. The service checks constructability issues in residential renovation through mixed-reality surveys. The recordings concern tests by Univpm and JEA at the JEA experimental building in Cáceres on 14–15 December 2021, including audio recorded by participating volunteers. The related IFC project-information model links object identifiers to 33 audio URLs from this restricted collection. The recordings therefore document the source-linked building-model verification activity; they are not numerical energy-simulation outputs. Zenodo exposes metadata but restricts file access, with permission requested from the authors. Licence, price and media encoding are unknown. Coverage is one building and two test days. A limitation is that no media or participant-level content was obtained, and access permission or consent conditions were not assessed.
